comments.content: The empty catch block silently swallows ALL errors from `Bun.file(SHELL_GITIGNORE).text()`, not just file-not-found (ENOENT). If the read fails due to a permission error (EACCES), the path being a directory, an encoding issue, or any other I/O failure, the code treats it identically to a missing file — masking real problems. This violates the async error-handling requirement and makes debugging impossible. Distinguish ENOENT (expected, treat as empty) from genuine errors (log to stderr so operators are aware).
